stage.note: Blaxel (YC S25) was an independent seed-stage startup until it was acquired by Baseten, announced 2026-09-10; deal terms and Blaxel's prior fundraising amounts were not disclosed in any source found. It now operates as part of Baseten rather than as an independently-funded company.

last_round.quote: Today, Blaxel is joining Baseten. By joining forces, we aim to build the cloud for the next trillion agents.

note: Blaxel was a San Francisco-based, YC S25-batch startup (founded 2024, ~12 employees) building Firecracker microVM sandboxes for AI agents. It was acquired by Baseten (announced 2026-09-10; deal terms undisclosed) and is now integrated into Baseten's agentic infrastructure platform; the blaxel.ai pricing/product referenced in the pricing card is stated to remain unchanged post-acquisition. The YC directory entry for 'Blaxel' (Spring 2025, status 'Acquired') matches the blaxel.ai domain and founder Paul Sinaï listed as Founder/CEO on blaxel.ai — confirming this is the same company, not a different 'Blaxel'.
